case_title: TIMOTHY HU VS. DRAGON SEED BRIDAL AND PHOTOGRAPHY

docket_entries.description: DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) FILED BY DEFENDANT DRAGON SEED BRIDAL AND PHOTOGRAPHY

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF APR-19-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO MAY-20-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF TIMOTHY HU IS PRESENT ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPRETER REBECCA CHAU. DEFENDANT DRAGON SEED BRIDAL AND PHOTORAPHY IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY EVA LOU, WEDDING PLANNER ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPRETER AMANDA PEETERS. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $1090 (INCLUDES COSTS) TO THE PLAINTIFF. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE MAY 20TH HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE, OR PAYMENT IS FRUSTRATED. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE 4/22 HEARING. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,108.06 FILED BY HU, TIMOTHY AS TO DEFENDANT DRAGON SEED BRIDAL AND PHOTOGRAPHY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-04-2022 AT 05:30 PM IN DEPT 506
ORDER TO CONTINUE TO PROVIDE INTERPRETERS

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF APR-04-2022 - CONTINUED FOR INTERPRETER TO APR-19-2022 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF TIMOTHY HU IS PRESENT ASSISTED BY NON CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPRETER FRANCIS HA. MR. HA WAS GIVEN THE INTERPRETER'S OATH BY THE COURTROOM CLERK. DEFENDANT DRAGON SEED BRIDAL AND PHOTOGRAPHY IS PRESENT. BOTH PARTIES REQUESTED A CANTONESE INTERPRETER. NO PROOF OF SERVICE FILED. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE ISSUES. NO FUTHER SERVICE IS REQUIRED. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER TO CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT. PLAINTIFF TIMOTHY HU IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT DRAGON SEED BRIDAL AND PHOTOGRAPHY IS NOT PRESENT. PLAINTIFF IS CALLED BY COURT ON 5-20-22. PLAINTIFF INFORMS THE COURT THAT THIS MATTER IS RESOLVED AS AGREED PER THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM WILLIAM LYNN; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
ORDER DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. CASE SETTLED.
